method: Serial samples; fresh BatchRunner worker per sample, reused across independent cases.
No RunSession/proof reuse, coverage or profiling; installed Python/native-solver wheel.
Cold worker startup is included; filesystem caches may be warm on later runs.
Equal aggregate configured solver allowance per holding, split across independent cases.
Solver allowances may include model conversion; actual native search is recorded separately.
Separate wall/RSS guards cover preparation, conversion, search and validation.
Worker RSS uses Linux VmHWM sampled every 50 ms and at shutdown; guards may overshoot.
Independent totals describe separate hypothetical realms, not a legal joint layout.
Model counts sum largest observed formulation per stage/case; stages are not added.
Unavailable native build/search splits remain null; raw phase/timing keys retained.
